name: sandbox-mcp
tagline: MIT CLI (sbx) plus optional MCP server by Scott Hanselman that boots a fresh, network-off Windows Sandbox, deploys your app, drives it with UI Automation, keeps screenshots and crash evidence, then deletes the machine — catches "works on my machine" bugs in ~40-50 s (needs Windows Pro/Enterprise/Education)

xSignals.text: A lot of people don't realize that Windows has a built-in feature called Windows "Sandbox" that boots up a brand new virtual Windows machine in seconds. So I made an MCP server so you can test your apps inside a throwaway machine in seconds.
